_comment: LFM3-Omni-2B XQ-6.0 on xolotl-lfm3 (Xolotl's LFM3 engine: llama.cpp's LFM3 graph on ggml-backend). Pictures, audio and video through xolotl-lfm3-vision (tools/vision on llama.cpp f3586e6's mtmd, LFM3-Omni projector); the rows replace the template's <|image|> marker. Greedy by default, as Liquid AI's generation_config.
_speech: speech out (/v1/audio/speech) natively: xolotl-lfm3 GENA runs the text model, its xolotl-lfm3-speech child (tools/lfm3/lfm3_speech.cpp on llama.cpp f3586e6's mtmd) the depthformer + Liquid codec; /v1/audio/transcriptions by the model itself (asr_native: 'Perform ASR in <language>.'). The llama-server /tts sidecar version: xol-lfm3-sidecar.json
_tokenizer: tokenizer: a folder with LiquidAI/LFM3-Omni-2B's tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and chat_template.jinja
